Runs a free pulmonary rehabilitation programme over WhatsApp for people with lung disease such as COPD in India. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from January 2024, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="respira-health-aim">33</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

| Model | By | Date | Years of healthy life per $1,000 | Cells reproduced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Respira Health: digital pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD (Ambitious Impact, 2025 idea report)](/respira-health) | AIM | January 2024 | <span data-figure="headline" data-model="respira-health-aim">33</span> | 56 |

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Respira Health existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Respira Health runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://respirahealth.org)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
